page.title: Theme
page.intro: Choose the colors, shapes and font of the app. Labels like tier headers, chains and the report button always stay readable, so a theme that would make them hard to read can't be saved.

preset.default: App default (follows your device's light or dark mode)

type.sizeHelp: The accessibility text size in Display settings takes priority over this.

preview.label: Preview
preview.author: alex
preview.body: This is how a post reads with this theme.
preview.muted: Secondary text, like times and counts.

errors.theme_contrast: {check, select, integrity {Labels like tier headers and the report button would be too hard to read. Pick label colors with more contrast.} text {Text would be too hard to read on these backgrounds.} muted {Secondary text would be too hard to read on these backgrounds.} links {Links would be too hard to read on these backgrounds.} other {Some text would be too hard to read with these colors.}}
errors.theme_invalid: This theme has a value that isn't allowed.
errors.rate_limited: You've changed your theme a lot today. Try again later.

advanced.intro: Write your own CSS to restyle anything in the app. image(name) uses an image you upload below, for example to turn the like button into a picture. Theme CSS only affects what you see, and it isn't applied on sign-in, recovery, settings or moderation pages, so you can always come back here to undo it.
advanced.placeholder: [data-part=like] '{' background: image(heart) center / contain no-repeat; font-size: 0; min-inline-size: 40px; '}'
advanced.example: Handy hooks: .shell (the page), .post (a card), .post-body, button, button.primary, [data-part=like], [data-part=save], .nav-list a, .brand.
advanced.imagesOff: Image uploads are off on this server, so theme CSS can't use images right now.
advanced.imageName: Image name (lowercase letters, digits and dashes)
advanced.imageNameBad: Use a name that starts with a letter and has only lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
advanced.imageNameTaken: This theme already has an image with that name.
advanced.imagesFull: A theme can have up to 8 images.

errors.theme_css: Line {line, number}: image() names an image this theme doesn't have.
errors.whole: This theme CSS is too long (32 KB at most).

advanced.warning: Theme CSS can change or hide anything, including the labels that keep you safe: tier headers, chains, "Why am I seeing this?" and the report button. Only use CSS you wrote yourself or fully understand. Never paste CSS someone sent you.
